classification.method: Official FMA2Obj physical component memberships, with explicit source-name classification for branches outside those roots. Vascular membership takes priority. The organs study layer also contains residual tissues, not a claim that every residual surface is an organ.

criteria.scope: Skeleton surfaces only; identical authored FMA concept, BP representation and English name
criteria.grouping: Every pair in a group must satisfy every criterion; adjacent or dissimilar bones remain separate
criteria.default: Most source triangles, then stable numeric FJ order; original geometry is never moved, blended or dropped

lodPolicy.high: Every original 4.3 source triangle retained; no smoothing, subdivision or geometric decimation
lodPolicy.preview: Same coherent 4.3 geometry; 25% target, 80–12000 triangles per element, 0.5 mm estimated appearance error limit, locked boundaries
lodPolicy.quantization: Uniform 16-bit positions where measured vector error <=0.02 mm; float positions otherwise. Signed 16-bit authored normals, normalized. Preview and HIGH share the same transform.
